ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary contiguous white zones occupying the interior of the left and right lobes; left lobe features a distinct circular low-intensity spot near the lateral center; heavy low-intensity banding along the leading and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a measured internal angle of approximately 50 degrees and a vertical depth of ~45 pixels from the shoulder peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular sawtooth topography; left lobe contains 8 primary peaks; right lobe contains 7 primary peaks; peak-to-valley amplitude varies between 5 and 20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concave curve along the trailing edge extending toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast tan and white clusters located at the far lateral tips of both lobes, showing approximately 15-20 distinct pixel groupings on the right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple low-intensity vertical linear rake marks disrupting the white pigmentation zones on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular pigmentation mark (black) centrally located within the white patch of the left lobe; visible barnacle encrustations on the distal lobe tips.
